204756195_1a9e4c96.text: Using this approach, four subsets of neurons were identified, each distinct in their anatomical distribution and efferent projection pattern. In addition, an unexpected projection to the orbital frontal cortex and insular cortex was found arising from outside of the LC, contradicting the dogmatic view that the LC is the lone noradrenergic nucleus projecting to the cortex (Robertson et al., 2013)
